SCE.S:5B5854: My high school girlfriend, met again after 12 years. Married after I left the City; single now.
SCE.S:5B59EC: Patrol cop for New Town. His beat rarely sees real crime, so he's not used to cases.
SCE.S:5B5AB8: Watching patients deform, something in her broke. She came to work with her father's hunting rifle.
SCE.S:5B5B84: In for his appendix. On a stroll he met a man with a giant head and fled to a toilet.
SCE.S:5B5C50: Grandson of a famed germ expert; now he hunts the cause of the strange disease.
SCE.S:5B5DE8: Actually an orthopedic surgeon. Level-headed; stays calm even in a crisis.
SCE.S:5B5EB4: From Brazil. Works as a guard while at language school. His grandfather came from this City.
SCE.S:5B5F80: Works near this hospital. A 2cm jointed leg sprouted from her gums. It keeps growing; it no longer fits in her mouth.
SCE.S:5B604C: Her mind changed fast instead of her body. She gained a kind of clairvoyance and healing power.
SCE.S:5B6118: Thinks of himself as rational, but is truly sadistic and twisted.
SCE.S:5B61E4: Confused, losing his judgment. Seeing the isolation-ward patients, he fears he'll end up the same.
SCE.S:5B62B0: Loves hospital gossip. Sometimes invades patients' privacy, but doesn't care.
SCE.S:5B637C: First agent sent here. The government half knew what would happen to him.
SCE.S:5B6448: Helped found the hospital. Moved to the mountains when his wife died. Fascinated by changes of body and mind.
SCE.S:5B6514: Always deeply interested in human death. Now he feels he understands the world of the dead.
SCE.S:5B65E0: Wrapped in deep grief. Chose medicine after her dear, kind uncle died of illness. All this has badly shaken her.
SCE.S:5B66AC: Wrapped in deep suffering. Couldn't adapt to the change. Longs with all his heart for his old body.
SCE.S:5B6778: His body is shriveling but his mind slowly grows. Still, he feels like a victim.
SCE.S:5B6844: In a rage she flung her visiting parents into subspace. Deep remorse led to a wrong change.
SCE.S:5B6910: Even in pain he keeps his reason; he wants to keep his dignity whatever he becomes.
SCE.S:5B69DC: He was not malicious, but he lacked kindness toward others. Dying, he saw that this caused it all.
SCE.S:5B6AA8: Hospital director, uncle of his deputy. A title, nothing more.
